szoveg_eredeti:
We’re partnering with Inferact to advance production inference for MiniMax models, with engineering improvements contributed back to @vllm_project.

Thanks to the Inferact team for supporting M3.1 Flash in production from day one. Looking forward to building together!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet MiniMax (official) megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Inferact (@inferact); megjelent: 2026-10-23T01:11:38+00:00; link: https://x.com/inferact/status/2113438162961961221; média: nincs média]
Today, we are announcing a strategic partnership with @MiniMax_AI to advance frontier production inference for open-source models.

The Inferact Platform has served MiniMax M3.1 Flash in production since the day it launched. Requests through the MiniMax platform are routed to our stack alongside MiniMax’s own capacity, after we met MiniMax’s vendor verification requirements for accuracy and reliability.

The Inferact Platform serves this agentic workload with guaranteed SLAs and auto-tunes the endpoint against live traffic, while MiniMax keeps control of how its model is served.

Inferact also leads day-0 @vllm_project support for each MiniMax release, so the model serves at production quality the day the weights ship. The engineering from both efforts is upstreamed to vLLM.

Thanks to the MiniMax team for the partnership. Read the full announcement:
https://inferact.ai/news/minimax-partnership
